review_notes: I read the whole file. It introduces no definitions, structures or classes. It only contains theorems. Most are thin re-exports of lemmas in AVenhance.Infra.Classical.Uniqueness, plus one proof that a continuous periodic function with zero L² norm is zero. The concepts it uses (spaceGrad, spaceLap, vecDot, l2NormSq, IsZ2Periodic, unitCellAt) are defined in other files. Duplicating a theorem is outside this rubric, which covers duplicated concepts. I did not check those other files for competing definitions, because they are outside the target. Nothing in the target file is a competing version of a Mathlib concept.
